title: L3 Dependency Choice Input
description: Stage 5 of smart-guideline-end-to-end: the L1 knowledge graph, the L2 assets of stage 4, and any candidate IGs already known.

l2Assets.description: The artifacts of every stage-4 l2-dak-authoring pass.

l2Dependencies.description: Stage 3's rows: an IG that implements a reused DAK is a candidate.

candidates.description: IGs already known to bear on the use case.

candidate.title: Dependency candidate
candidate.description: A DAK or IG that might be built on: cat-harness DependsOnRecord's three fields (the same as FHIR ImplementationGuide.dependsOn) and its publisher. A candidate missing packageId, version or uri is a DependsOnGap, not a candidate. Defined by the l2-dependency-choice input contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

dependencyChoice.title: Dependency choice
dependencyChoice.description: The output of a dependency-choice stage (3 at L2, 5 at L3): one row per candidate, rejected ones included, the gaps, and the question put to the adjudicator. Defined by the l2-dependency-choice output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

gaps.description: Candidates missing packageId, version or uri (DependsOnGap), each with what is missing.

decisionRequest.description: Path or URL of the DecisionRequest (cat-harness schemas/decision-request.ts) the adjudicator answers. Under the QA rule the agent has already gone on with its recommendation.

dependencyRow.title: Dependency decision row
dependencyRow.description: One candidate and the decision about it. Only decision, reason and toolchain are new; the rest is cat-harness DependsOnRecord and smart-base KG evidence. Once adjudicated, a reuse, adapt or extend row becomes an ordinary dependency: the DAK's own reference at L2, a sushi-config.yaml dependencies entry at L3. Defined by the l2-dependency-choice output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

upstream.description: For a jurisdiction's adaptation: the packageId of the WHO original, recorded as its upstream.

evidence.description: The KG node ids that point at the candidate: L1 nodes at L2; L1 nodes and L2 assets at L3 (smart-base KG evidence).

decision.description: reuse: unchanged. adapt: fork and change. extend: depend and add. reject: not used.

reason.description: One sentence; required for reject (stated here rather than as if/then, which the conformance reader does not take).

id.description: A DAK component at L2 (personas, business-processes, ...); a profile, value set or library canonical at L3.

toolchain.description: For a component reused, adapted or extended: how the candidate produces it, so stages 4 and 6 produce it the same way. A Tool id from bun run cat check:tools, or a script in the candidate's own repository (its source spreadsheet, converter, CQL refresh, test format), found by the search in smart-base-tools section Adapting a DAK. none only after that search came back empty, naming where it looked; the new tool is then a Tool node, never a script in the adaptation repository.

components.description: What is taken from the candidate, piece by piece.

l1Extraction.title: L1 extraction
l1Extraction.description: One source's L1 knowledge graph. Defined by the recommendation-extraction output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

id.description: The library id of the source.

coverage.description: Share of the source's recommendation sentences extracted verbatim; the gate is 1.

warnings.description: Every WARNING, verbatim: no persona or process fitted, a sentence not matched, and so on.

skipped.description: True when the extraction was already there at this sourceVersion and was not redone.

l1Kg.title: L1 knowledge graph
l1Kg.description: Stage 2's output and the L1 input of stages 3 and 5: one extraction per included source. Defined by the recommendation-extraction output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

l2Artifact.title: L2 artifact
l2Artifact.description: One L2 asset the authoring wrote. Defined by the l2-dak-authoring output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

useCase.title: Use case
useCase.description: What the guideline is for, in the requester's words. Stage 0's output and every later stage's context. Defined by the guideline-use-case output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

setting.description: Where care happens: community, primary care, hospital, and so on.

jurisdiction.description: WHO (a global guideline) or the country or region adapting one; an ISO 3166 code where there is one.

kind.description: A new guideline, or an adaptation of an existing one.

adapts.description: For an adaptation: the guideline or DAK being adapted, by name or canonical.
